claims.value: 21 April 1498: Gualtiero da Bascapè reports Leonardo promises to finish by September
claims.statement: A letter of the ducal secretary Gualtiero da Bascapè to Ludovico Sforza, April 1498, reports that the large room (camera grande) is being cleared of its planks and quotes 'Magistro Leonardo promete finirla per tuto septembre'. Day given as 21 April by one source, 20 April in the draft query; a second letter of the 23rd reports the room free of the boards.

claims.value: Name 'Sala delle Asse' given by Luca Beltrami
claims.statement: The name Sala delle Asse (room of the planks) derives from the wooden boards mentioned in the 1498 letters and was given by Luca Beltrami during his restoration of the castle in the late nineteenth century.
